title: Differentiable Exact Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.21486v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce a framework for differentiable exact learning that couples an unbounded external environment to a state-tracking neural controller, which we train on policy-trajectory observations (PTOs): expert behavior traces that expose observations and actions while hiding internal states. In addition to the learning framework, we introduce Differentiable Finite-State Transducers (DFSTs) which use multilinear updates, support log-parallel training, and emulate arbitrary finite-state controllers, yielding computational universality through environmental interaction. From tiny training datasets, compact DFSTs achieve extreme length generalization on arithmetic and universal-simulation tasks. We replicate the success of DFSTs on RNNs and GRUs, thereby supporting a broader learning recipe: State-Tracking Controller + Unbounded External Environment + PTOs = Extreme Length Generalization. tldr: 该论文提出可微精确学习框架与可微有限状态转换器（DFST），仅需极小的训练数据集即可在算术和通用模拟任务上实现极端长度泛化，并将成功经验总结为学习公式“状态跟踪控制器 + 无界外部环境 + 策略轨迹观测 = 极端长度泛化”。
